requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product should provide only one consistent name/reference for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series across all customer-facing platforms to reduce user confusion and errors.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must reliably print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types under all specified climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform, meeting regional print quality and intervention specifications.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must operate as intended without input tray sensor failure or flag breakage when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, tablecloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer should be evaluated for functional failures when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing (per CISS product standards).

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must print without print quality issues when placed on a trolley, in accordance with standard UBT requirements.
